olivia: Heads-up — a community user reported our ruby gem breaks Sorbet typecheck on arm64 CI after the 0.8.1 release. Sampleapp CI fails on ruby-3.2 with a Sorbet error in the generated client.

devex-bot: buildkite: https://ci.example.com/builds/4421 — `srb tc` failed (exit 1).

sam: Can you paste the minimal failing log and the failing method signature?

olivia: Pasted snippet from the CI log:
```
/opt/builds/sampleapp/lib/redwood_client/generated.rb:42: Method `create` has incompatible return type for `T::Sig` declared: Expected: `String`, Got: `T.untyped` (https://srb.help/xxxx)
  42 | sig { params(payload: T.untyped).returns(String) }
```
Also tried `rbenv local 3.2.2` on mac M1 and reproduced locally with `bundle exec srb tc`. The generator started emitting stricter sigs after last generator change in main. I opened a tiny PR to relax the sig to `T.untyped` for now: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/342

taro: OK — sounds like a parity/compat problem between generator templates and the sampleapp's Sorbet config. Quick workaround is to emit `# typed: false` at top of generated file or make the sig params `T.untyped`. Long-term we should keep generator output Sorbet-compatible across supported ruby versions.

sam: I skimmed the PR — small and safe. Please add a CI test that runs `bundle exec srb tc` on the sampleapp matrix (ruby 3.2, linux/arm64 if possible). Without a regression test this will keep biting us.

olivia: Good call. I'll add a minimal `spec/sorbet_smoke_spec.rb` that runs `system('bundle exec srb tc')` and mark it as smoke so it only runs in the sorbet job. Also planning to backport to the 0.8.x branch if we get +1.

jess: I can review now. Two quick asks: 1) include a one-line changelog entry (docs/CHANGELOG.md) mentioning Sorbet relax, 2) add a comment in generator template explaining why we use `T.untyped` so future maintainers don't flip it back inadvertently.

olivia: will do both. prepping updates and test.

sam: After you push tests ping me and I'll run the arm64 image locally to sanity-check.

devex-bot: PR 342 status: reopened by olivia with new commit. CI queued.

olivia: pushed tests + changelog + generator comment. PTAL.

jess: LGTM with one nit; approving now. Please backport if you can. :thumbsup:

olivia: Thanks — merging and will open a backport to 0.8.x. Noting follow-ups: add an explicit Sorbet job to our sampleapp CI matrix and document generator Sorbet rules in devex/README.md.

sam: Thanks for the quick turnaround. Glad it was small.

devex-bot: PR 342 merged by jess. CI: green.
